name: Diesel engine generator sets
description: Prime/standby/emergency electrical power for platforms and plants, driving emergency lighting, fire pumps, drilling equipment and process loads. Compact high-power-to-weight packages are favoured offshore; paralleling and system controls are provided by integrated power systems.

MTU diesel generator set page: 'up to 3,250 kWe (60 Hz) and up to 4,000 kVA (50 Hz)'; 85% load factor standby, 75% prime
